stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in generative AI tasks.
The model is categorized under key ML frameworks like transformers and utilizes safetensors.

stories.title: China’s Alibaba takes another swipe at America’s AI supremacy
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: Alibaba has unveiled Qwen3.8-Max, claiming it is their largest and most capable AI model to date.
The company asserts that Qwen3.8-Max rivals leading US AI models from Anthropic and OpenAI.
The release signals a significant competitive challenge to US AI dominance from major Chinese tech players.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation tasks, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors, placing it within the current LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
The associated tags (transformers, llama, safetensors) confirm its relevance within the modern AI/ML ecosystem.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements translate to higher quality model responses.
The updated engine also enables faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, offering an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating local LLM usage.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, leveraging Apple's native ML framework.
The feature is currently available in a preview build, indicating active development and optimization.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It connects these apps to local AI coding agents.
A key feature is that all AI processing runs entirely on the user's local device for privacy.

stories.title: ExtractBench: A Benchmark for Schema-Guided Enterprise Document Extraction
stories.author: Simon Suo
bullet_points: Introduces ExtractBench, a new benchmark specifically designed for schema-guided document extraction in enterprise settings.
It is notable for being the first benchmark to simultaneously evaluate value accuracy, record completeness, grounding, and measured cost.
The benchmark tests agent performance on a large-scale dataset comprising 4,869 pages across 370 enterprises.

stories.title: TokTier: Exact Stateful Tokenization for Agentic LLM Serving
stories.author: Zhichao Cao
bullet_points: TokTier addresses the inefficiency in LLM serving where front ends re-tokenize full requests instead of leveraging cached KV state.
The problem is acute in agentic systems, where frequent small appends to long transcripts complicate token boundary reuse.
Empirical data shows that while most calls append small amounts of data, session rebuilding remains a significant overhead in current LLM serving architectures.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across diverse hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving capabilities on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of 'subagents' for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added to Claude Code via Ollama, enhancing its real-time knowledge access.

stories.title: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
stories.author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
bullet_points: Generative AI models are being trained on artists' work without explicit permission.
Artists view this practice as theft, while AI proponents argue it is necessary for technological evolution.
The issue has escalated into contentious legal battles concerning intellectual property rights in AI.

stories.title: As Reddit stock falls, CEO questions value of Google's AI Overviews
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: Reddit is reportedly re-evaluating its licensing agreement with Google.
The uncertainty is linked to the recent performance and perceived value of Google's AI Overviews.
The situation highlights ongoing tension and commercial negotiations between major tech players regarding AI data usage.

stories.title: Defcon's new badge is a security key you can see inside
stories.author: Kim Zetter, wired.com
bullet_points: Defcon's new security badge incorporates a visible, removable chip.
This design allows hackers to inspect the badge's internal components.
The chip enables unauthorized use of the badge even after the event concludes.

stories.title: Google plans to exempt sanctioned nations from Android developer verification
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google is planning to exempt sanctioned nations from Android developer verification requirements.
This change allows developers in countries like Cuba or Iran to continue installing APKs without new restrictions.
The policy shift is expected to negatively impact developers operating within these sanctioned regions.

stories.title: AgentHPOBench: A Benchmark For Evaluating LLM Agents as Sequential Hyperparameter Optimizers
stories.author: Xuanjing Huang
bullet_points: Introduces AgentHPOBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate LLM agents' capability as sequential hyperparameter optimizers.
Addresses a gap in current LLM evaluation by focusing on an agent's ability to interpret experimental evidence and guide subsequent decisions, rather than just static output.
Signals a shift in AI evaluation towards assessing autonomous, experimental capabilities of LLMs as they evolve into scientific agents.

stories.title: When Does On-Policy Interaction Help? Representational Tradeoffs in Value-Based Imitation Learning
stories.author: Dylan J. Foster
bullet_points: The paper addresses limitations of standard Behavior Cloning (BC) in Imitation Learning (IL), specifically compounding errors.
It investigates the role of on-policy interaction in improving IL performance, particularly when expert policy representation is imperfect.
The research explores representational tradeoffs as a method to enhance agent learning beyond simple demonstration replication.

stories.title: FriendBench: Benchmarking Dyadic Familiarity Inference in Humans and Multimodal Large Language Models
stories.author: Benjamin Peloquin
bullet_points: Introduces FriendBench, a new benchmark for assessing dyadic familiarity inference.
The benchmark evaluates models' ability to determine if two people are familiar or strangers based on short (20-second) conversational clips.
Compares 26 models from seven companies across text, audio, and video modalities against human panels.

stories.title: TraceViT: Grounded Trace Supervision for Visual Abstract Reasoning
stories.author: Wei Hua
bullet_points: Introduces TraceViT, a new looped visual reasoner designed for visual abstract reasoning tasks like ARC.
Addresses a limitation in conventional training where intermediate refinement steps in looped reasoners are unconstrained.
Proposes training the reasoner by enforcing that step-by-step refinements follow the inferred transformation.

stories.title: DungeonBench: A Benchmark for Rules-Rich Tactical Reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons Combat
stories.author: Kaan Oktay
bullet_points: Introduces DungeonBench, a new benchmark designed to test rules-rich tactical reasoning.
The benchmark focuses specifically on Dungeons & Dragons combat, addressing limitations in current AI testing suites.
It aims to measure the ability of AI to make complex decisions considering geometry, timing, resources, and intricate rule interactions.

stories.title: Sign compression for Muon: SignMuon, MuonSign, and the Limits of Error Feedback
stories.author: Alexey Kravatskiy
bullet_points: Introduces SignMuon, a method that compresses the Muon update to one bit per parameter using elementwise sign.
SignMuon achieves a low communication budget, outperforming SignSGD in practical applications.
The research investigates the limitations of error feedback, showing that signing the gradient before the LMO can lead to convergence issues.

stories.title: GQ-FSL: Green Quantized Federated Split Learning
stories.author: Lutz Lampe
bullet_points: Addresses energy and resource constraints when deploying deep neural networks (DNNs) on mobile edge devices.
Proposes Green Quantized Federated Split Learning (GQ-FSL) to mitigate overheads in traditional Federated Split Learning (FSL).
Focuses on reducing energy consumption (EC) associated with continuous data and submodel exchange in edge AI.

stories.title: When Does On-Policy Interaction Help? Representational Tradeoffs in Value-Based Imitation Learning
stories.author: Dylan J. Foster
bullet_points: The paper addresses limitations in Imitation Learning (IL), specifically the compounding errors of standard Behavior Cloning (BC).
It investigates the role of on-policy interaction in improving IL performance when perfect expert representation is unattainable.
The research focuses on representational tradeoffs as a key factor in enhancing imitation learning algorithms.

stories.title: A Human-Centered Validation of the Explainability-Performance Coefficient
stories.author: Luis F. Lago-Fernández
bullet_points: Addresses the critical need for trustworthy Explainable AI (XAI) in high-risk domains.
Proposes a new model-agnostic metric, the EPC score, to quantify explanation quality.
Focuses on balancing explanation fidelity with human-centered understanding, a current research challenge.

stories.title: QASP: Query-Adaptive Robust Vector Search Policy
stories.author: Andy Warfield
bullet_points: Addresses the core challenge in vector search: balancing high recall with low computational cost.
Introduces QASP, a novel policy that predicts the entire recall progression curve for each query.
Moves beyond simple average recall evaluation to account for significant per-query performance variance.

stories.title: The Parts Are Greater Than the Sum: Automated Task Sequencing for Efficient Training of Multi-Policy LLMs
stories.author: Adam Sobey
bullet_points: Addresses the interference problem in Multi-Policy LLM training when using shared PEFT methods like LoRA.
Proposes a novel optimization approach to overcome limitations of existing methods that rely on a shared optimization path.
Focuses on improving task sequencing efficiency and mitigating catastrophic forgetting in heterogeneous LLM adaptation.

stories.title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Xipeng Qiu
bullet_points: The paper introduces WCM, a World Critic Model designed for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Reinforcement Learning.

It addresses a critical limitation in current RL methods for robotic manipulation: the reliance of critics on single-frame observations, which conflicts with the partially observable nature of real-world robot control.
WCM aims to overcome the exponential complexity associated with naively incorporating full observation history into the critic.

stories.title: FriendBench: Benchmarking Dyadic Familiarity Inference in Humans and Multimodal Large Language Models
stories.author: Benjamin Peloquin
bullet_points: Introduces FriendBench, a new benchmark for inferring dyadic familiarity (stranger vs. familiar) from short conversational clips.
Evaluates 26 models from seven companies across text, audio, and video modalities against human panels.
Focuses on the non-verbal and behavioral aspects of social interaction, moving beyond purely linguistic analysis.

stories.title: ResKV: Reconstructing Omitted Attention Contributions for Fixed-Budget KV Cache Compression
stories.author: Shuo Shang
bullet_points: The paper addresses the critical need for efficient KV cache compression in long-context LLM inference.
Existing compression methods either permanently discard valuable attention contributions or perturb retained data.
The proposed 'ResKV' method formulates omitted cache information as residual statistics within the softmax attention mechanism.

stories.title: ARB: A Matched Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark Dataset for AI-Text Detector Evaluation
stories.author: Simon Pietro Romano
bullet_points: Introduces ARB (Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark), a new dataset for evaluating AI-text detectors.
Addresses a gap in current benchmarks by testing detectors on human text rewritten by LLMs, rather than just direct LLM output.
Aims to determine if detector performance on conventional benchmarks accurately predicts behavior when human content is paraphrased by AI.

stories.title: Evidence-Type Competition: When Can Interventional Data Teach Language Models Causal Direction?
stories.author: Xining Xun
bullet_points: The study challenges the assumption that interventional data is always sufficient to teach causal reasoning in Language Models (LMs).
In controlled synthetic environments mimicking Simpson's paradox, increasing interventional data does not improve the model's ability to infer causal direction.
The research suggests that the magnitude of the model's 'do()-response' grows monotonically even when causal direction is not learned effectively.

stories.title: Know It, Act on It: Investigating Memory Utilization in LLM Personalization
stories.author: Emmanuele Chersoni
bullet_points: Investigates the critical issue of memory utilization in personalized Large Language Model (LLM) agents.
Addresses the 'knowledge utilization problem,' where LLMs may possess relevant user preferences but fail to act upon them.
Aims to distinguish whether LLM failures stem from poor memory retention or poor application of stored context.

stories.title: Bridging the Question-Answer Gap in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Hypothetical Prompt Embeddings
stories.author: Aleksandar Tošić
bullet_points: The research addresses a core challenge in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): the style mismatch between user queries and retrieved document content.
It proposes a method involving 'Hypothetical Prompt Embeddings' to improve alignment between queries and context, aiming to overcome limitations of existing runtime solutions like HyDE.
The work focuses on improving RAG efficiency and accuracy by addressing the gap between the query space and the document embedding space.

stories.title: Critical CVE issued for hallucinated SQLite vulnerability
stories.author: ymir_e
bullet_points: A critical CVE has been issued concerning a vulnerability in SQLite.
The vulnerability is described as being related to 'hallucinated' behavior, suggesting an AI/ML interaction or misinterpretation.
The news originates from Hacker News, indicating a technical audience interest in security flaws.

stories.title: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
stories.author: Anon84
bullet_points: Demonstrates highly efficient LLM inference capabilities.
Achieves 70B parameter model inference on minimal hardware (single 4GB GPU).
Highlights advancements in quantization or model optimization techniques (AirLLM).

stories.title: Show HN: Nightcrawler – A local AI pentesting agent running on a smartphone
stories.author: NickySlicks
bullet_points: Introduction of 'Nightcrawler,' a local AI agent designed for penetration testing.
The agent is specifically engineered to run directly on a smartphone.
This represents a niche application of on-device AI in cybersecurity/pentesting.

stories.title: The Memory Wall
stories.author: diyaburman
bullet_points: Addresses a critical, high-failure rate issue (97.5%) in deployed AI agent tasks.
Proposes that four specific failure modes exist that current development layers (spec, test, skill) cannot resolve.
Indicates a deep, practical problem in AI productionization, suggesting a need for novel architectural solutions.

stories.title: Long-Running AI Agents Accumulate Context Debt
stories.author: vincent_tuan
bullet_points: The article discusses 'Context Debt' in long-running AI agents.
This debt arises when agents accumulate extensive context from multiple data sources (e.g., finance, CRM).
The concept is illustrated using an agent preparing a monthly operating review.
